defs.name: Smart Home: Room Navigator Sidebar
defs.genInstructions: Build a vertical sidebar listing the home's rooms (Living Room, Kitchen, Bedroom, Office, Garage, Outdoor) with icons, active-device counts, an 'All Rooms' entry and a search field, so selecting a room scopes the rest of the panel to that space.
defs.role: It is the primary spatial filter of the panel, scoping the device grid, climate, scenes, cameras and energy views to one room or the whole home.

effectors.name: Smart Home: Device Control Grid
effectors.description: When devices are toggled on/off in the grid, it emits the updated on-count for the currently selected room, and the sidebar updates that room's active-device badge and online/offline dot in real time.

targets.name: Smart Home: Device Control Grid
targets.description: On room selection (or 'All Rooms'), emit the roomId; the grid re-queries and re-renders only the device tiles assigned to that room, resetting scroll and its category filter to 'All'.

targets.name: Smart Home: Climate & Thermostat Dial
targets.description: On room selection, emit the roomId; the thermostat switches to that room's zone, showing its current temperature, target setpoint, humidity and HVAC mode, or the whole-home average when 'All Rooms' is selected.

targets.name: Smart Home: Scene & Automation Board
targets.description: On room selection, emit the roomId; the board filters scene cards and automation rules to those scoped to that room, showing global/home-wide scenes when 'All Rooms' is selected.

targets.name: Smart Home: Security Camera Wall
targets.description: On room selection, emit the roomId; the camera wall filters its feed tiles to cameras and sensors located in that room, and shows all feeds in mosaic when 'All Rooms' is selected.

targets.name: Smart Home: Energy Usage Monitor
targets.description: On room selection, emit the roomId; the energy monitor re-scopes its consumption chart and per-device breakdown to only devices in that room, or whole-home totals for 'All Rooms'.

defs.name: Smart Home: Device Control Grid
defs.genInstructions: Build a responsive grid of device tiles (lights, plugs, blinds, locks, speakers, fans) each with an on/off toggle, contextual slider (brightness, position, volume), device name, state text and category filter chips; it is the main hands-on control surface.
defs.role: It is the central device manipulation surface where the user directly switches and adjusts every controllable device in the selected room.

effectors.name: Smart Home: Room Navigator Sidebar
effectors.description: Receives the selected roomId and re-renders only that room's device tiles, resetting scroll and category filter to 'All'.

effectors.name: Smart Home: Scene & Automation Board
effectors.description: When a scene is activated, receives the scene's device state payload (per-device power, brightness, color, blind position) and animates the affected tiles to their new toggle and slider values.

targets.name: Smart Home: Room Navigator Sidebar
targets.description: On each toggle change, emit the room's new active-device count so the sidebar badge and status dot update immediately.

targets.name: Smart Home: Energy Usage Monitor
targets.description: On toggle or slider change, emit deviceId plus new power draw estimate; the monitor updates its live wattage total and the device's bar in the consumption breakdown.

targets.name: Smart Home: Device Detail Panel
targets.description: Clicking a tile's name or info affordance emits the deviceId; the detail panel opens with that device's full controls, schedule, usage history and settings.

defs.name: Smart Home: Climate & Thermostat Dial
defs.genInstructions: Build a circular thermostat dial with drag-to-set target temperature, current temp and humidity readout, HVAC mode selector (heat/cool/auto/off), fan speed, and a mini 24h temperature trend sparkline for the selected zone.
defs.role: It is the dedicated climate control station for the currently selected room's HVAC zone.

effectors.name: Smart Home: Room Navigator Sidebar
effectors.description: Receives the selected roomId and switches to that zone's sensor data, setpoint, mode and trend history.

effectors.name: Smart Home: Scene & Automation Board
effectors.description: When a scene containing climate settings is activated, receives the target temperature, HVAC mode and fan speed and animates the dial to those values.

targets.name: Smart Home: Energy Usage Monitor
targets.description: On setpoint or HVAC mode change, emit the new mode and delta from ambient; the monitor recalculates and re-renders the HVAC portion of the consumption chart and projected daily cost.

defs.name: Smart Home: Scene & Automation Board
defs.genInstructions: Build a board of tappable scene cards (Good Morning, Movie Night, Away, Goodnight) plus a list of automation rules with trigger/action summaries, enable switches and schedule times; activating a scene pushes its device and climate states across the panel.
defs.role: It is the orchestration layer that applies multi-device presets and time/trigger-based rules to the rest of the panel.

effectors.name: Smart Home: Room Navigator Sidebar
effectors.description: Receives the selected roomId and filters scene cards and automation rules to those scoped to that room, showing home-wide items for 'All Rooms'.

targets.name: Smart Home: Device Control Grid
targets.description: On scene activation, emit the scene's per-device state payload (power, brightness, color, blind position); the grid applies and animates each affected tile to the new state.

targets.name: Smart Home: Climate & Thermostat Dial
targets.description: On activation of a scene containing climate settings, emit target temperature, HVAC mode and fan speed; the dial animates to the new setpoint and mode.

targets.name: Smart Home: Security Camera Wall
targets.description: On activation of a security-relevant scene (e.g. Away, Goodnight), emit the arm state; the camera wall switches its arm/disarm indicator, enables motion recording and highlights armed feeds.

defs.name: Smart Home: Security Camera Wall
defs.genInstructions: Build a mosaic of live camera feed tiles with timestamps, motion-detected badges, an arm/disarm control, door/window sensor status list and a recent security events log.
defs.role: It is the surveillance and security-status surface, scoped by room and armed by scenes.

effectors.name: Smart Home: Room Navigator Sidebar
effectors.description: Receives the selected roomId and filters visible camera feeds and door/window sensors to that location, showing the full mosaic for 'All Rooms'.

effectors.name: Smart Home: Scene & Automation Board
effectors.description: Receives the arm state emitted by security-relevant scenes and updates the arm/disarm indicator, motion recording flag and armed-feed highlighting.

targets.name: Smart Home: Device Detail Panel
targets.description: Clicking a camera tile emits its deviceId; the detail panel opens showing that camera's enlarged feed, recording settings, motion sensitivity and event history.

defs.name: Smart Home: Energy Usage Monitor
defs.genInstructions: Build an energy panel with a live wattage total, a time-series consumption chart with day/week/month range toggles, a per-device consumption breakdown bar list and projected cost estimate.
defs.role: It is the consumption analytics view that reflects the real-time power impact of every device and climate change made elsewhere in the panel.

effectors.name: Smart Home: Room Navigator Sidebar
effectors.description: Receives the selected roomId and re-scopes the chart and breakdown to that room's devices, or whole-home totals for 'All Rooms'.

effectors.name: Smart Home: Device Control Grid
effectors.description: Receives deviceId plus updated power draw on every toggle or slider change and updates the live wattage total and that device's bar in the breakdown.

effectors.name: Smart Home: Climate & Thermostat Dial
effectors.description: Receives HVAC mode and setpoint changes and recalculates the HVAC share of the consumption chart and projected daily cost.

defs.name: Smart Home: Device Detail Panel
defs.genInstructions: Build a right-side detail drawer that shows the selected device's large preview/controls, connection and battery status, per-device schedule, usage history graph and settings (rename, room assignment, notifications).
defs.role: It is the deep-dive inspector for any single device selected from the grid or camera wall, complementing their at-a-glance controls.

effectors.name: Smart Home: Device Control Grid
effectors.description: Receives the deviceId when a tile's name or info affordance is clicked and opens showing that device's full controls, schedule, history and settings.

effectors.name: Smart Home: Security Camera Wall
effectors.description: Receives the camera deviceId when a feed tile is clicked and opens with the enlarged feed, recording settings, motion sensitivity and event history.
